summary: Practice grant reconciliations, control reviews and audit evidence workflows. Explore the five-day donor finance course and plan your next step.
lede: Donor compliance and financial audit preparation apply award terms to spending, records and reporting, and make transaction evidence traceable. For grant finance officers, project accountants and internal auditors, the work includes reviewing expenditure eligibility and preparing clear responses to audit queries. Practise reconciling grant ledgers, tracing procurement from approval to payment, checking partner expenditure and organizing evidence using COSO control concepts and ISA 500 principles.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who maintain donor-award records, verify spending or coordinate financial audit work. It suits intermediate practitioners with working familiarity with project finance, accounting records or grant-funded operations.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with project finance, accounting records or grant-funded operations is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Spreadsheet exercises use Excel where available; no specialist software installation is required.
topics: Financial management for NGOs & donor-funded projects
